## Ruling recorded · #30220 edit-wizard site · option A

The maintainer (Yibo Wang) tapped 「A 只读已存记录判定（推荐）」 on the seat's decision card at 2026-11-05T10:50Z. The card asked 「编辑向导里，已处于必填闸门内却缺值的记录该怎么处理？」.

What A means (os-dev-report 6650598384, option A): in `WizardForm.gateFinalSubmit`, on an Edit wizard only, after the live verdict, skip a field when `requiredWhenRestsOnStoredRecord(field.requiredWhen, name, persistedRecord, predicateScope)` is true and the field is not statically required. The live `resolveFieldRuleState` call still binds no `previous`, so objectui#8069's option-D refusal (no new binding pipeline) and its accepted `visibleWhen` residual are unchanged.

Out of A: B (binding `persistedRecord` as the gate's live `previous`) and C (keeping the wizard as a residual).

Carrier: the same card thread, pushed onto PR #30301 before it lands, which then switches from `Refs #30220` to `Fixes #30220`.
